title: Analytics Engineer - Data Platform (m/f/d)
description:
At Statista, we’re all about facts and data, for we are the world's leading business data platform. By providing reliable and easy-to-use data as well as various data analytics products and services, we empower people worldwide to make fact-based decisions.

Founded in Hamburg in 2007, we have quickly grown into a global company with offices in major cities such as London, New York, Berlin and Tokyo. And we still have a lot of plans. Our constant growth does not only prove our success, but also keeps creating new development and career opportunities for our employees.

We value and celebrate our diverse culture. You are welcome here for who you are, no matter where you come from, what you look like, or whether you prefer bar graphs to pie charts. Your story matters – keep writing it as part of our team.

Are you ready to join us?

You’ll join Statista’s newly formed Data Platform team. We’re building a central platform that brings together data—from market statistics to consumer surveys—under consistent standards for quality, documentation, and access. This gives product teams and AI agents a trusted foundation to build new applications and features without duplicating data or setting up separate pipelines.

Your role

  • Design, implement, and maintain backend services in Python that power our data access and distribution layer

  • Build and operate automated build, test, and deployment pipelines following CI/CD and GitOps practices, running on AWS and Kubernetes

  • Design and maintain data models and schemas (Avro, SQL) for our data pipelines and services, and publish them to downstream consume

title: Medical Data Analyst (m/w/d)
description:
Hol' dir den Kick als DocCheck

Medical Data Analyst (m/w/d)

Patient:innendaten verwalten? Für dich fängt die Arbeit da erst an. Du liebst Medizin und willst mit Technik und KI neue Antworten finden, statt den Status quo nur zu bedienen? Als Medical Data Analyst bei DocCheck baust du ein neues Geschäftsfeld in unserer eigenen Marktforschung mit auf. Im Herzen der DocCheck Community hast du direkten Zugang zur Zielgruppe. Du entwickelst aus anonymisierten Patient:innendaten Analysen und Handlungsempfehlungen für die Pharmaindustrie und prägst ein Data-Lake-Projekt von der ersten Idee an. Du hast keine Lust mehr, dich zwischen Medizin und Technik zu entscheiden? Worauf wartest du! DocCheck versetzt den kompletten Gesundheitsmarkt in absolute Effizienz-Ekstase. Egal ob News, Foren, Fachartikel, Medizinshop oder Kreativ-Agentur – DocCheck rührt den Medicals die ultimative Service-Mischung an.



Deine Substanz

Du hast einen Abschluss in Pharmazie, Medizin, Biomedizin, Public Health oder einem vergleichbaren Fach und kennst die medizinische Versorgungsrealität. Du bringst zwei bis vier Jahre Erfahrung mit Gesundheits- oder Real-World-Daten oder aus der Pharma-Marktforschung mit. ICD-10, ATC-Codes, Wirkstoff vs. Präparat und Therapielinien sind für dich Alltag. Du erkennst unplausible Werte, stellst die richtigen Fragen an Daten und weißt, welche Erkenntnisse für die Pharmaindustrie wirklich zählen. SQL oder Python sind ein Plus. Du arbeitest dich gerne mit KI-Tools in Datenbankabfragen ein. Ein sorgfältiger Umgang mit sensiblen Daten, Datenschutz und Arzneimittelsicherheit ist für dich selbstverständlich.

title: Software Engineer (Python & Cloud)
description:
Build the software behind large-scale battery storage

Solar and wind power are not always available when we need electricity. Large-scale battery storage helps by storing electricity when supply is abundant and releasing it when demand rises. This keeps the grid flexible and reduces reliance on fossil fuels.

But how do you connect a battery site of hundreds of megawatts to a central IT platform? And how do you build software that is ready for the projects still to come? As a Software Engineer at GIGA Storage, these are the challenges you will work on.

About GIGA Storage

Founded in 2018, we are an international scale-up growing across the Netherlands, Belgium and Germany. Our purpose, ‘Unlock every Green Watt’, is about making the energy system better and more affordable for future generations. We aim to have 1.5 to 2 GW of battery power operational by 2030. At 2 GW, that is theoretically enough peak power to supply more than a million homes simultaneously.

We pioneer at a scale where many solutions are still being developed. We take ownership, share knowledge and make decisions together. Rapid growth also calls for adaptability: priorities shift and not everything is defined in advance.

Your role

You develop and grow our Giga platform. You build software in Python, working with technologies including SQL, Terraform, Grafana and data processing. You do not need to know everything already: you enjoy learning beyond your own specialism.

title: Platform Engineering Internship - Observability
description:
